name: Groom
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 0, legendary ninja 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a mirror)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target touched creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The touched creature is cleaned up as if they took a bath, cleaned with soap, their hair, both head and body, are trimmed or cleaned up to local fashion and their worn clothing is cleaned up and smoothed out.

This does not repair any damage to weapons, armor, or clothing, but at least they’re cleaned and polished. The subject creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus on Charisma-based skill checks for 24 hours or until they take a bath or get dirty.
